problems.title: First-time visitors land on sign-in and try to sign in with an account they never created
problems.statement: Three of the four sessions open the sign-in page, fill in an email and a password, press Sign in, and only then go looking for the sign-up link. The screen a new visitor is given is the one for people who already have an account, and the route for people who do not is discovered by failing first. A 401 is recorded on the product's own origin in three of the four sessions.
observedIn: s-vibe-builder beats 2-7, then a 401 in its console errors
s-just-looking beats 2-6, ends on /sign-in with a 401
matchAny: sign in with an account they

problems.title: No session got the product connected to anything
problems.statement: Across four sessions, zero reached the point where Growthmind was watching a product. Every session ends unresolved, either by leaving or by running out of attempts. The furthest any of them travelled was the first of the setup steps.
observedIn: all four sessions, outcome is gave_up or step_cap, none completed

problems.title: The analytics connection is where every session that reaches setup stops
problems.statement: Two of the four sessions reach the first-run page, type into an API key field and a host field, press the same button two or three times, and end there. A 400 from the server is recorded on the product's own origin in three of the four sessions. Connecting an analytics account is the first thing asked of a new account and it is where the furthest-travelling sessions stop.
observedIn: s-vibe-builder beats 20-26 then session ended, with a 400 in its console errors
s-sceptical-founder beats 15-21 including a 10s wait, then session ended, with a 400

problems.title: The sign-up form is submitted before it can succeed, then has to be filled in again
problems.statement: One session pressed the submit button, then filled in the name and email fields, then pressed submit a second time. The form accepted a press it could not act on, and what was still missing became clear only after the press.

problems.title: The Slack step sends the session onto slack.com and it does not come back
problems.statement: One session's page trail leaves the product for slack.com's workspace sign-in and ends there. The setup step hands the person to another company's login, and the session neither returns to Growthmind nor completes the step.
observedIn: s-engineer-in-a-hurry urlTrail ends at slack.com/workspace-signin, beats 1-6 are all on slack.com
matchAny: does not come back to the product

problems.title: A visitor can leave from the sign-in page having seen nothing of what the product does
problems.statement: One session's entire page trail is the sign-in page. It fills the form, presses Sign in, gets a 401, and ends. There is nothing on that screen that shows what the product does, so a visitor who will not create an account first leaves knowing nothing.
observedIn: s-just-looking urlTrail is /sign-in only, 7 beats, outcome gave_up
matchAny: never sees what the product does
nothing about what the product does
no way to evaluate the product
